payroll.label: Employee remuneration included in operating results

source.label: Finance Report 2025, Note 25 Employee benefits, employee remuneration (millions of CHF)
source.quote: Employee remuneration in millions of CHF 2025 2024 Wages and salaries 12,630 12,441 Social security costs 1,192 1,223 ... Employee remuneration included in operating results 17,028 16,836

notes: Employees: year-end 2025 headcount. Roche switched in 2025 from full-time equivalents to headcount and widened the scope to ESRS (adding apprentices, interns and people on unpaid leave), so the 2024 figure of 103,249 FTE is not comparable; the report says the workforce was broadly unchanged on a comparable basis. Payroll: 'Employee remuneration included in operating results' (wages and salaries 12,630, social security 1,192, defined contribution 470, defined benefit operating expense 545, equity compensation 857, termination costs 618, other benefits 716; CHF million). It excludes the CHF 133m net interest cost of defined benefit plans, which brings 'Total employee remuneration' to CHF 17,161m. Swiss filer: no CEO pay ratio.
